_comment: Definitions for common UI/platform events not covered in the main event-dictionary.md. These are merged at runtime by emit_instrumentation.py.
home_page_v2: Home page loaded (V2 — primary home event, carries user super-properties)
dynamic_base_page: Dynamic (webview) page loaded — path identifies the page
dynamic_image_tapped: User tapped a dynamic image/card — id identifies the entry point, path is the destination
dynamic_image_viewed: Dynamic image/card entered viewport — id identifies the element
dynamic_animation_tapped: User tapped a Lottie/animated element (replaces dynamic_image_tapped for animated variants)
page_load_duration: Page load performance — path identifies the page, time_to_load is ms, is_loaded_from_cache indicates warm/cold
profile_menu_item_clicked: User tapped an item in the profile/settings menu — id identifies the item
dashboard_nav_click: User tapped a tab in the bottom/top navigation bar — nav_text is the label, index_tapped is position
share_app_clicked: User initiated app sharing — link contains the generated referral/share URL
experimental_flags: Feature flag assignments loaded for this user session — contains experimentalFeatureFlags object
personalization_context: Full personalization payload — feature flags, user state, cohort props, nested in experimentalFeatureFlags and props objects
app_resume: App resumed from background (not a real event — session marker when no splash_screen is found)
dynamic_info_copy: User copied text from a dynamic info element
dynamic_nudge_viewed: In-app dynamic nudge/tooltip shown to user
dynamic_nudge_action: User interacted with a dynamic nudge
dynamic_popup_menu_opened: Popup/overflow menu opened on a dynamic page
dynamic_popup_menu_clicked: User selected an item from a popup menu
generic_bottomsheet_stickyButton_clicked: User tapped the sticky CTA button on a bottom sheet
generic_page_sticky_button_clicked: User tapped a sticky button on a page
video_carousel_swipped_event: User swiped in a video carousel
api_call_failed: An API call failed — contains endpoint and error details
